name: posts
help: the posts by stage: the gate that waits, preview and url, how many review rounds

args.name: stage
args.help: only the posts at this stage of the project's config

name: show
help: one post with its gates, review rounds and comments

args.name: slug
args.help: the post's slug

name: set
help: set a post's stage, title, links, figures or a gate's state; a new slug makes the post (writer)

args.name: slug
args.help: the post's slug

args.name: stage
args.help: the stage it enters; one with a gate opens it

args.name: title
args.help: the post's title

args.name: branch
args.help: the branch its draft is on

args.name: preview_url
args.help: the preview link of the draft

args.name: url
args.help: the published post

args.name: published_at
args.help: when it went out, ISO 8601

args.name: d7
args.help: the figures 7 days after it went out, as a JSON object

args.name: d28
args.help: the figures 28 days after it went out, as a JSON object

args.name: evidence
args.help: what shows it entered the stage

args.name: gate
args.help: the stage of the gate to set

args.name: gate_state
args.help: the gate's state

args.name: via
args.help: what the gate was answered through: hub when unsaid

args.name: answer
args.help: the answer to the gate, such as the option chosen

name: recall
help: what to read before a stage: its notebooks' entries and those about the post, seen most first

args.name: stage
args.help: the stage about to start

args.name: post
args.help: the post's slug

args.name: q
args.help: only entries with every word of it

name: feedback
help: the feedback notebook: list its entries, add one (writer), or record that one came back (writer)

args.name: action
args.help: list, add or repeat

args.name: entry
args.help: with repeat: the entry, PH-<n>

args.name: notebook
args.help: list: only this notebook; add: the entry's notebook

args.name: post
args.help: list: only entries about this post; add: the post it came from

args.name: stage
args.help: list: only the notebooks read before this stage

args.name: seen
args.help: list: only entries seen at least this many times

args.name: q
args.help: list: only entries with every word of it

args.name: title
args.help: add: the entry's title

args.name: said
args.help: add, repeat: what the person said, in their words

args.name: date
args.help: add: the day of the entry; repeat: when it was said; today when unsaid

args.name: note
args.help: add, repeat: where it was said, such as the post

args.name: agent_wrote
args.help: add: what the agent wrote

args.name: person_fixed
args.help: add: what the person changed it to

args.name: rule
args.help: add: the rule it gives

args.name: check
args.help: add: how the rule is checked

args.name: probe_id
args.help: add: the curator probe that checks the rule

name: import
help: write the posts and entries of a JSON file, keeping their ids; a second run adds nothing (admin)

args.name: file
args.help: the JSON file, as export --format json prints it

name: export
help: the feedback notebook as its markdown files, or everything import takes

args.name: notebook
args.help: only this notebook

args.name: format
args.help: markdown (the default) or json
